question: Approve the design and enter implementation as Pilot? Approving accepts the recommendations D1 (chief-engineer is owed at the third Feedback Cycle, Spacedock's own stop, not the second), D2 (a waiver line 'Reviewer: <agent> not run: <reason>' is allowed), D3 (engineering-reviewer is owed after his answer on an amendment and before the applying worker is dispatched), and FO's implementation order below.

artifacts.summary: Design: a 'same class twice' detector was probed and rejected (fires on 9 of 13 archived tasks, 0 paths in relay, misses one cited case). Events instead: the third Cycle entry owes chief-engineer; an amendment whose Supersedes or Design is not none owes engineering-reviewer. New role_triggers.py read by pr_watch.py tasks gives FO an idle next: line; the observer reports an owed call as a violation. Cost: 10 Opus calls would have been owed on 2026-10-15/16 (13 through 10-17); tokens unmeasured. README words: net zero under the ratchet. AC-1 to AC-9; only the corpus probes behind AC-1 and AC-7 have run. Implementation order (FO, from the six Batch overlap sections): workflow-budget-ratchet and prod-security-validation-gate first in parallel; after the ratchet merges, worker-loads-declared-package, ui-design-review-in-ideation and special-role-triggers; merge-gatekeeper after prod-security-validation-gate (both edit delivery_gate.py). At most three workers at once.
